description: When the launcher shows its lockout page instead of the home screen, and the reload reports search-unreachable (#229). One table for both sides: LockedOutTest (core:config) reads it against the file's state, LockoutTest (app:ui) against the launcher's own check. A case added here is checked by both. Gestures not named are none.

cases.case: a hidden bar with nothing set
a hidden bar with a gesture to search
a hidden bar with a gesture to the launcher's settings
a hidden bar with only notifications
a hidden bar with every other action
a hidden bar whose gesture opens an app
